# Tesserae 0.1.0
The first public release of Tesserae, a disk-space visualiser for macOS.
## What it does
- **Scans fast.** A Rust engine reads a whole volume in parallel. On an Apple Silicon Mac it scans about a million files every 3.5 seconds, even with a cold cache. - **Starts with your disks.** Choose from This Mac, Other disks and Network, or choose a folder. Return to the list with ⌘⇧N; ⌘⇧O scans the startup disk. - **Shows where the space went.** A treemap you can zoom into, coloured by folder with depth shading (⌘1), age (⌘2) or Type focus (⌘3). Folder name strips and a hover path help you find your place. A sortable folder tree shares selection with the map; switch to Largest Files for the top 1,000 files in view. - **Names every control.** Toolbar controls have help and accessibility labels. User-facing strings live in translation-ready catalogs; this release ships English. - **Accounts for the whole disk.** The space breakdown sets what the scan found against what the volume reports, including the system volume and free space. It shows the gap as a signed figure: positive is space the scan can't see; negative means shared (cloned) blocks were counted twice. Local snapshots are listed, but macOS doesn't report their size. - **Never hides what it couldn't read.** Unreadable folders, skipped locations, cloud-only files, and partial or interrupted scans are all counted and named. The scan report collects them, and Copy Diagnostics copies it to the clipboard. - **Works without Full Disk Access.** A Limited scan skips the folders that would raise privacy prompts. Tesserae explains why it asks for Full Disk Access, and the grant takes effect after a relaunch. - **Reclaims space with a review.** Stage files and folders in Reclaim Space and choose Move to Trash, Compress or Archive per item. Unavailable actions show a reason, and warnings need individual acknowledgement. The app checks identities again before acting and keeps an audit log. - **Compresses in place.** Transparent compression on local, writable APFS/HFS+ keeps files readable by your apps. Estimates are labelled; results report measured savings. Recently compressed offers Decompress for the unchanged files Tesserae compressed. - **Archives before moving originals to the Trash.** Apple Archive LZFSE is the APFS/HFS+ default; ZIP is the default elsewhere. tar.xz is also available, with Apple Archive LZMA and tar.zst under Advanced (LZFSE is Advanced on other disks). Finder opens ZIP, tar.xz and Apple Archive; tar.zst needs zstd installed or an app such as Keka. File hashes, entry types, sizes and symlink targets are verified before originals move; xattr contents aren't byte-verified. On failure, originals stay. Empty the Trash to reclaim space; if the disk has no Trash, both copies stay. - **Handles Mac metadata companions.** On exFAT/FAT, recognised paired AppleDouble `._` sidecars are metadata. Orphan or real `._` content needs Apple Archive; formats that can't preserve it are disabled. Put Back is available where the filesystem supports safe restoration; on exFAT, use Finder's Put Back.
## Install
- **Download:** `Tesserae-0.1.0.dmg` below. Open it and drag Tesserae to Applications. The app is signed, notarized and stapled. - **Homebrew:** `brew install --cask sdelavega/tap/tesserae`
Requires macOS 13 Ventura or later, on Apple Silicon or Intel.
## Getting started
Choose a volume on the start screen and click **Scan**, or use **Choose a Folder…** (⌘O). Grant Full Disk Access for a complete scan. Click tiles to zoom in, and ⌘↑ to go back up. Use **File → Scan Another Location…** (⌘⇧N) to choose again, or ⌘⇧O for the startup disk. The README has a [full walkthrough](https://github.com/sdelavega/tesserae#using-tesserae).
## Updates
Tesserae updates itself with [Sparkle](https://sparkle-project.org). It checks a signed feed once a day, sending only the app and macOS versions. You can check by hand from **Tesserae → Check for Updates…**, or turn automatic checks off in **Settings**.
## Privacy
No telemetry. The only network traffic is the update check, which you can turn off.
## Feedback
This is a first release, and feedback shapes what comes next. Please [open an issue](https://github.com/sdelavega/tesserae/issues/new) for bugs, confusing numbers or ideas. For scan problems, **Scan report → Copy Diagnostics** gives the details; check it for file names you'd rather not share first.
## Credits and licences
Transparent compression uses the bundled GPL-3.0-or-later [applesauce](https://github.com/Dr-Emann/applesauce) helper, pinned to [applesauce-cli-v0.5.30](https://github.com/Dr-Emann/applesauce/releases/tag/applesauce-cli-v0.5.30). Tesserae's GPL-3 licence, applesauce's licence and dependency notices are bundled in the app, available from **About Tesserae → Licenses**.
